verdict.rationale: Recurring job scheduling is a fair question for a SaaS experimentation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows scheduling of individual flag rules and automatic ramp-ups (release plans and ramp schedules). Those are one-off or progressive time-based rollouts, not recurring jobs or workflows, and no recurring schedule capability is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
